rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

The requirement has one MUST: the description states when to use the skill, in terms of the user's task. The `description` in the front matter does this. It opens with "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing". It then lists the situations where `cargo test` or `habeas status` reports missing, stale, or false evidence, uncovered lines, and similar findings. It also covers the user who only says "the habeas test is failing". These are all described by what the user is trying to do or what they see, not by the skill's internals.

The description ends with "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement allows this with a MAY. `assets/skills/habeas-refactor` exists as a bundled skill, and it is a sensible skill to confuse with this one.

No violation queries are listed for this site, and I found no gap.
